recent.quoted_text: 1.8 seconds. That’s how long Cam Skattebo stayed in his stance after the snap on this critical 3rd & 1. He didn’t reach the pile until about 2.8 seconds had elapsed. By then, Winston’s initial push had already been stopped. The Giants fell just short and ultimately punted https://t.co/kBiriesIgD

recent.text: This was not a Tush Push, Giants coach John Harbaugh explained today, just a “normal QB sneak.” So RB Cam Skattebo was not supposed to come in on the snap and push Jameis Winston from behind. I still don’t understand his odd freeze and delay, though. https://t.co/Sf65ZJ0XC7

recent.text: I asked John Harbaugh about that fourth down play in which Cam Skattebo delayed coming forward and why that was. He clarified it wasn't a tush push, but rather a QB sneak. He also mentioned that they have different types of sneaks in the playbook. So no, Skattebo was not asleep

recent.text: Giants WR Malik Nabers on the fateful last non-catch: “I mean, seeing the ball go up at the time, I didn’t really see (the defender) or where he was. My head was looking up at the ball. Seeing how high the ball was, I made an adjustment to catch the ball and he made a play.”
